summary: This Form 6-K is a routine disclosure by Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ: BYAH) of a comprehensive strategic partnership with Star Plus Action (HK) Limited, a subsidiary of Star Plus Legend Holdings. The press release describes a non-binding collaboration to integrate resources in healthcare, skincare, celebrity IP, and AI, launching a pilot product called the AI Nutritionist. There are no definitive terms, financial commitments, or governance changes. The filing simply announces a business relationship per foreign private issuer reporting obligations under Rule 13a-16. Absent any acquisition, divestiture, tender, or activist elements, this is a routine current report on Form 6-K.
